title: What If You Flew Into the Sun's Atmosphere?
subject: Parker Solar Probe

scenes.text: What if you flew into the Sun's atmosphere? One spacecraft already did, and it survived.
NASA's Parker Solar Probe passed about 3.8 million miles above the Sun's surface.
It moved at about 430,000 miles an hour, the fastest thing humans have ever built.
Its carbon foam shield faces temperatures of roughly 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
Behind that shield, the instruments stay near room temperature.
The probe is not touching the Sun's surface. It flew through the thin, scorching corona, and a shadow kept it alive.
